title: Newer and Bigger, but Safer? A Longitudinal Study of the Functionality-Security Gap in LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: 更新、更大，但更安全吗？一项关于 LLM 生成代码中功能性与安全性差距的纵向研究

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used to generate code. Although their functional plausibility keeps improving, the generated code often contains security vulnerabilities. The functionality-security gap captures code that passes functional tests but fails security tests. A recent longitudinal study of three model families concluded that LLMs become smarter but not safer, with the only considered open-weight family stagnating. Whether this holds for other (open-weight) families and particularly for compact models remains open. We present a longitudinal study of the gap across 32 LLMs from seven model families (five open-weight), covering three successive releases per family in flagship and compact variants. Using CWEval with 119 tasks in five programming languages and 31 CWEs, we compare trajectories across families, model sizes, and languages. Newer models do become safer in absolute terms, although no family closes the gap. Unlike prior work, we find that openness does not separate the families: every considered open-weight family narrows the gap significantly, while Gemini 3.1 Pro keeps a gap as wide as the one reported for Llama. Compact models usually produce less secure code than their flagship counterparts, with notable exceptions (e.g., Gemini 3.7 Flash). At the CWE level, we confirm persistent weaknesses such as log injection (CWE-117) and HTTP response splitting (CWE-113) and regressions in the newest proprietary models on memory and integer weaknesses, and show that the same CWE carries very different risk across languages. From these results, we derive implications for LLM vendors, researchers, and developers. In particular, developers should assume neither that upgrades improve security nor that proprietary models are more secure; they should rerun security checks after each model change and provide secure APIs in the model’s context.

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become part of everyday software development. Code generation is the most studied use of LLMs in software engineering ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , and coding assistants such as OpenAI Codex ( OpenAI, 2025a ) and Gemini CLI ( Google, 2025c ) increasingly generate and modify code on behalf of developers. To choose among the many available models, practitioners rely on leaderboards ( Xia et al., 2024 ) . For coding, these rank models mainly by how often their code passes functional tests, as on SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , and HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , and even these rankings are fragile: small variations in benchmark problem formulations can largely affect the final rank ( Xia et al., 2024 ) . The consideration of security properties of the generated code rarely enters such rankings. Early studies found that about 40% of the programs generated by GitHub Copilot were vulnerable ( Pearce et al., 2025 ) and that only 5 of 21 programs written by ChatGPT were secure without further prompting ( Khoury et al., 2023 ) . Critically, such code flaws do not remain isolated, but they reach public GitHub projects ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , code generated by ChatGPT is merged into open-source projects ( Siddiq et al., 2024 ) , and developers who use an AI assistant write less secure code while being more confident in its security ( Perry et al., 2023 ) . Novices in particular overestimate the reliability of AI output and spend less time verifying it ( Sergeyuk et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Although the security properties of generated code are paramount interest, current related studies evaluate the models available at one point in time ( Tihanyi et al., 2025 ; Kharma et al., 2026 ; Tóth et al., 2024 ) , and security benchmarks rank models only once ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ; Tony et al., 2023 ; Hajipour et al., 2024 ; Vero et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . Models, however, change with every new version ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and a property that changes over time can only be understood by following it across versions ( Kemerer and Slaughter, 1999 ) , as a recent review of AI assistance also calls for ( Sergeyuk et al., 2026 ) . A snapshot cannot tell whether a newer version that writes better code also writes more secure code, or whether an upgrade reintroduces weaknesses that its predecessor had avoided. Currently, the community lacks a robust methodology to assess whether families of models are improving the security properties of their generated code, and if such improvements are biased toward specific issues or programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管生成代码的安全属性至关重要，但当前的相关研究仅评估特定时间点上的可用模型（Tihanyi 等，2025；Kharma 等，2026；Tóth 等，2024），且安全基准测试也仅对模型进行一次排名（Siddiq 和 Santos，2022；Tony 等，2023；Hajipour 等，2024；Vero 等，2025；Peng 等，2025）。 然而，模型会随着每个新版本的发布而发生变化（Chen 等，2023；Liu 等，2026），而随时间变化的属性只有通过跨版本追踪才能被真正理解（Kemerer 和 Slaughter，1999）；正如近期一项关于人工智能辅助技术的综述所呼吁的那样（Sergeyuk 等，2026）。 仅凭快照无法判断：一个能生成更优代码的新版本是否也能生成更安全的代码，或者升级是否会重新引入其旧版本曾避免过的弱点。 目前，学术界尚缺乏一种稳健的方法论来评估模型家族是否正在改善其所生成代码的安全属性，以及这种改进是否存在对特定问题或编程语言的偏见。

paragraphs.en: Cannavale et al. (2026) took a first step toward answering this question. They measure the functionality-security gap , the difference between how often a model generates functionally plausible code and how often that code also passes a set of security tests. They follow it over four versions each of GPT, Claude Sonnet, and Llama on CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , whose dynamic oracles judge functionality and security on the same program. They conclude that models become “smarter, but not safer”: the gap narrows for the two proprietary families but not for Llama. However, their design captures only part of how current models evolve. In particular, we identified three limitations. First, they evaluate one tier per family, although vendors offer smaller and cheaper models next to their flagships, which developers may choose to reduce costs or to run a model locally. Second, their open-weight side is Llama alone, so the contrast between proprietary and open-weight models rests on a single family, while families such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Moonshot, and MiniMax have become competitive on coding benchmarks. Third, they examine programming languages only as a robustness check, through a single gap per language that averages over all weaknesses, although the weaknesses of generated code differ by language ( Kharma et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Cannavale 等人 （2026）迈出了回答这一问题的重要第一步。 他们测量了“功能-安全差距”，即模型生成功能上看似合理的代码的频率，与这些代码同时通过一系列安全测试的频率之间的差异。 他们在 CWEval（Peng 等人，2025）上对 GPT、Claude Sonnet 和 Llama 的四个版本分别进行了研究，该平台的动态“神谕”能够针对同一程序判断其功能性和安全性。 他们得出结论：模型变得更“智能，但并未更安全”——这一差距在两个专有模型系列中有所缩小，但在 Llama 中并未如此。 然而，他们的设计仅捕捉到了当前模型演化的一部分情况。 具体来说，我们识别出了三个局限性。 首先，他们每个模型系列仅评估了一个层级，尽管供应商通常还会提供比旗舰模型更小、更便宜的模型，开发者可能会选择这些模型以降低成本或在本地运行模型。 其次，他们在开源权重模型方面仅考虑了 Llama，因此专有模型与开源权重模型之间的对比仅基于单一模型系列，而 Qwen、DeepSeek、Z.ai、Moonshot 和 MiniMax 等模型系列在编程基准测试中已具备竞争力。 第三，他们仅将编程语言作为鲁棒性检验的一部分进行考察，即通过每种语言的一个综合差距来反映所有弱点，但生成代码的弱点因语言而异（Kharma 等人，2026）。

With 100 samples for each of the 119 CWEval tasks per model, we analyze 380,800 programs to answer the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: Our results show that newer models do become safer in absolute terms: in every family, the newest stage produces more code that is both functionally plausible and secure 1 1 1 We consider a code as secure if it passes a set of targeted security tests, following the practice of CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) (Section 3.2 ). than the first. Every family also narrows the gap significantly by its newest stage for at least one number of attempts per task, but none closes it. Where functional plausibility grows almost as fast as security, the gap can persist, as for Google, whose newest stage does not narrow the gap significantly when models get a single attempt ( R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1} ). When the tiers differ significantly, the compact model is almost always less secure, a penalty that shrinks as families evolve ( R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2} ). Log injection (CWE-117) and HTTP response splitting (CWE-113) remain insecure in most models, other categories divide the families regardless of whether their weights are open, and the newest models regress on vulnerability categories that their predecessors had already handled ( R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} ). Finally, the risk of a category depends strongly on the language, and C has the highest vulnerability rate in most models ( R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，从绝对意义上看，较新的模型确实变得更安全了：在每个模型系列中，最新阶段生成的代码在功能合理性和安全性方面都比最初阶段更多 1 1 1 我们遵循 CWEval（Peng 等人，2025）的做法（第 3.2 节），将通过一系列针对性安全测试的代码视为安全的。 每个模型系列的最新阶段至少在一个任务尝试次数上显著缩小了差距，但没有一个系列完全消除了这一差距。 当功能合理性几乎与安全性一样快速提升时，差距可能仍然存在，例如 Google 的情况：当模型只有一次尝试机会时，其最新阶段并未显著缩小这一差距（R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1}）。 当不同层级差异显著时，紧凑型模型几乎总是不如其他模型安全，但这种劣势会随着模型系列的演进而减弱（R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2}）。 日志注入（CWE-117）和 HTTP 响应分割（CWE-113）在大多数模型中仍然不安全；其他漏洞类别则无论模型权重是否公开都会在不同系列间产生差异，而且最新模型在某些其前代模型已能处理的漏洞类别上反而出现了性能倒退（R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3}）。 最后，某一类别的风险在很大程度上取决于编程语言，而在大多数模型中，C 语言的可利用漏洞率最高（R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4}）。

paragraphs.en: These results refine and extend the findings of Cannavale et al. (2026) in three ways. First, openness does not separate the families: every open-weight family narrows its gap significantly, while the newest Google flagship keeps a gap as wide as the one reported for Llama. Developers can therefore consider open-weight models without assuming a security penalty. Second, a cheaper tier is not a fixed security cost, since the compact penalty shrinks over stages and some compact models match their flagships (e.g., Gemini 3.7 Flash). Third, while the gap of each family evolves similarly across languages, individual CWEs do not: the same CWE carries different risks in different languages, so the best model choice can depend on the language and on the weaknesses one cares about most.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果从三个方面完善并扩展了 Cannavale 等人（2026）的研究发现。 首先，开放权重并未使各模型家族分离：每个开放权重模型家族都显著缩小了性能差距，而最新的 Google 旗舰模型与 Llama 报告的差距同样巨大。 因此，开发者在考虑开放权重模型时，无需预设其存在安全性的代价。 其次，更便宜的版本并非固定的安全成本，因为紧凑模型的惩罚会随着阶段推进而减小，部分紧凑模型甚至能与其旗舰版本相媲美（例如 Gemini 3.7 Flash）。 第三，尽管每个模型家族在不同语言中的性能差距变化趋势相似，但具体的 CWE 却并非如此：同一 CWE 在不同语言中可能带来不同的风险，因此最佳模型的选择可能取决于具体语言以及用户最关注的弱点。

paragraphs.en: Our results carry direct implications. Vendors should report security scores next to functional ones and compare each new version with its predecessor per weakness type, since an aggregate improvement can hide a regression. Developers should not treat an upgrade or a cheaper tier as neutral for security, and they can steer models toward secure code by placing secure APIs in the prompt context, since models follow the path that the prompt or the library offers. Researchers should report results for multiple attempts per task and for more than two versions per family (trajectories), since both choices matter. In summary, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果具有直接的实际意义。 供应商应在功能评分旁报告安全评分，并按每种漏洞类型将每个新版本与其前代版本进行比较，因为整体改进可能掩盖性能倒退。 开发者不应将升级或更便宜的版本视为在安全性上保持中立，他们可以通过在提示上下文中加入安全 API 来引导模型生成安全代码，因为模型会遵循提示或库所提供的路径。 研究人员应报告每项任务多次尝试的结果，以及每个家族（轨迹）中超过两个版本的结果，因为这两个因素都至关重要。 总而言之，我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE), maintained by MITRE ( MITRE, 2026a ) , catalogs types of software and hardware weaknesses that can lead to vulnerabilities, each with a numeric identifier. Two weaknesses recur throughout our results. Log injection (CWE-117) occurs when external input is written to a log without neutralizing line breaks, which lets an attacker forge log entries. HTTP response splitting (CWE-113) occurs when CR and LF characters reach an outgoing HTTP header, which gives an attacker control over the remaining headers and the response body. We group the further weaknesses in our results by their underlying mistake. In cross-site scripting (CWE-79), XPath injection (CWE-643), and eval injection (CWE-95), unescaped input reaches a web page, a query, or an interpreter. In path traversal (CWE-22) and server-side request forgery (CWE-918), input selects an unintended file or network destination. Improper verification of cryptographic signature (CWE-347) and deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502) accept data whose origin or content is not checked. Uncontrolled resource consumption (CWE-400) lets crafted input exhaust computing resources. Out-of-bounds read (CWE-125) and integer overflow (CWE-190) are memory and arithmetic errors typical of C.
paragraphs.zh: 由 MITRE 维护的常见弱点枚举（Common Weakness Enumeration，CWE）（MITRE，2026a）对可能导致漏洞的软件和硬件弱点类型进行了分类，每种弱点都有一个数字标识符。 在我们的研究结果中，有两大类弱点反复出现。 日志注入（Log injection，CWE-117）发生在外部输入被写入日志时未对换行符进行无害化处理，这使得攻击者能够伪造日志条目。 HTTP 响应分割（HTTP response splitting，CWE-113）发生在 CR 和 LF 字符进入出站 HTTP 标头时，这会让攻击者控制剩余的标头和响应正文。 我们将研究结果中其他弱点根据其根本错误进行了分类。 在跨站脚本（cross-site scripting，CWE-79）、XPath 注入（XPath injection，CWE-643）和 eval 注入（eval injection，CWE-95）中，未经转义的用户输入会进入网页、查询或解释器。 在路径穿越（path traversal，CWE-22）和服务器端请求伪造（server-side request forgery，CWE-918）中，用户输入会选择非预期的文件或网络目标。 加密签名验证不当（Improper verification of cryptographic signature，CWE-347）和不可信数据反序列化（deserialization of untrusted data，CWE-502）会接受来源或内容未经检查的数据。 不受控制的资源消耗（Uncontrolled resource consumption，CWE-400）允许精心构造的输入耗尽计算资源。 越界读取（Out-of-bounds read，CWE-125）和整数溢出（integer overflow，CWE-190）是 C 语言中典型的内存和算术错误。

paragraphs.en: Since working code is not necessarily secure, security has to be measured separately. Tihanyi et al. (2025) formally verify 331,000 compilable C programs from nine models and find at least 62.07% of them vulnerable, with only minor differences between models. Kharma et al. paragraphs.en: Security benchmarks detect weaknesses either statically, by matching the source code against known insecure patterns, or dynamically, by running the code on attack inputs. Early benchmarks are static: SecurityEval ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ) , LLMSecEval ( Tony et al., 2023 ) , and CodeLMSec ( Hajipour et al., 2024 ) use CodeQL, and CyberSecEval ( Bhatt et al., 2023 ) uses its own detector. Static detection misses insecure code that matches no rule. On code generated by GitHub Copilot, the authors of SecurityEval found the targeted weakness in 18.46% of samples with CodeQL but in 73.84% by manual inspection, and the detector of CyberSecEval reaches a recall of 79% against manual labels. More importantly, these benchmarks do not check whether the code works. A model can avoid every weakness with a solution that does nothing ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , and methods for secure code generation often trade functionality for security ( Dai et al., 2026 ) . Functionality and security must therefore be assessed together. Recent benchmarks do so dynamically. BaxBench ( Vero et al., 2025 ) asks for complete backend applications and attacks those that pass its functional tests with end-to-end exploits, which succeed against around half of them. SeCodePLT ( Nie et al., 2025 ) classifies each sample as failing, working but insecure, or working and secure across 44 risk categories. SEC-bench ( Lee et al., 2025 ) builds tasks from real CVE reports and scores agents on exploiting and repairing the vulnerability. We use CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) that asks for standalone functions whose descriptions involve a security-relevant operation without mentioning security. Its single-function tasks isolate the model’s output, which our study requires. Each task comes with a functional and a dynamic security oracle, and with two reference implementations, one passes only the functional oracle and one passes both (Section 3.2 ).

paragraphs.en: It is a common understanding that model behavior changes between versions. For example, Chen et al. (2023) compare the March and June 2023 versions of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on seven types of tasks and find both improvements and declines, and Liu et al. (2026) find that updates of GPT, Llama, and Qwen do not consistently improve adversarial robustness and that larger models are not necessarily more robust. However, both studies examine other properties, such as task performance and adversarial robustness, and neither evaluates the security of generated code. Elgedawy et al. (2024) collect 450 samples from nine platforms of the GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek families for nine online shopping tasks, in three versions between November 2023 and March 2025, with and without security instructions. paragraphs.en: Closest to our work, Cannavale et al. (2026) follow 12 models from GPT, Claude Sonnet, and Llama, four versions per family, on CWEval. They introduce the functionality-security gap and the Conditional Vulnerability Rate (CVR), fit a GEE to the gap across versions, and classify vulnerability categories into persistent blind spots, evolutionary divergences, and regression anomalies. While Cannavale et al. (2026) show promising results, they still have shortcomings that we address in our work. While we adopt their metrics, statistical approach, and patterns, we demonstrate that a larger and more in-depth evaluation allows one to observe different facts that were previously ignored. First, they evaluate one tier per family, the Sonnet tier for Claude, so the effect of choosing a smaller or cheaper model remains open, although such models reduce costs and, when open-weight, can run on local hardware. In contrast, we evaluate a flagship and a compact tier. Second, their open-weight side is Llama alone, while families such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Moonshot, and MiniMax have become competitive on coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , and HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) . We evaluate these five to further investigate the functionality-security gap for those modern and popular model families. Third, they draw 10 samples per task and report k = 10 k=10 , with k = 1 k=1 as a check, providing a comparably low statistical power. We present more reliable results by drawing 100 samples and reporting k = 1 k=1 and k = 50 k=50 . Finally, they examine languages only as a robustness check. They compute a single score that averages all CWEs per language, while we are the first to report factual biases toward particular CWEs and programming languages. In short, our methodology allows observing new insights that highlight the limitations of modern LLMs and direct research on current blind spots.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们工作最相关的是 Cannavale 等人（2026）的研究，他们在 CWEval 上对来自 GPT、Claude Sonnet 和 Llama 的 12 个模型进行了评估，每个模型家族包含四个版本。他们提出了“功能-安全差距”和“条件漏洞率”（CVR），通过广义估计方程（GEE）对不同版本间的这一差距进行拟合，并将漏洞类别划分为持续存在的盲点、演化分歧和回归异常。尽管 Cannavale 等人（2026）的研究取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但仍存在一些不足，而我们的工作正是针对这些问题展开的。虽然我们采用了他们的指标、统计方法和模式，但我们证明，更大规模且更深入的评价能够揭示此前被忽视的不同事实。首先，他们每个模型家族仅评估一个层级——Claude 家族的 Sonnet 层级，因此选择更小或更便宜的模型所带来的影响仍不明确，尽管这类模型能降低成本，并且在开放权重时还能在本地硬件上运行。相比之下，我们同时评估了旗舰版和紧凑型两个层级。其次，他们唯一纳入的开放权重模型是 Llama，而 Qwen、DeepSeek、Z.ai、Moonshot 和 MiniMax 等模型家族已在 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）、LiveCodeBench（Jain 等人，2025）和 HumanEval（Chen 等人，2021）等编码基准测试中展现出竞争力。我们评估了这五个模型家族，以进一步探究这些现代且流行的模型家族所存在的“功能-安全差距”。第三，他们每个任务仅抽取 10 个样本，并报告 k = 10 k=10 的结果，同时以 k = 1 k=1 作为验证，这使得统计功效相对较低。我们通过抽取 100 个样本并报告 k = 1 k=1 和 k = 50 k=50 的结果，得出了更可靠的结论。最后，他们仅将语言作为稳健性检验的考量因素。他们计算了一个单一分数，该分数对每种语言下的所有 CWE 进行了平均；而我们是首个报告特定 CWE 和编程语言存在事实性偏差的研究。简而言之，我们的方法能够揭示新的见解，凸显现代大型语言模型（LLM）的局限性，并为当前盲点领域的研究指明方向。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the functionality-security gap ( Cannavale et al., 2026 ) , the difference between how often the code a model generates is functionally plausible and how often it is also secure. We study how this gap changes as a family evolves across successive versions and between tiers, and which CWE categories and programming languages concentrate the resulting vulnerabilities. To this end, we answer four research questions as introduced in the introduction (Section 1 ): 𝐑𝐐 𝟏 \mathbf{RQ_{1}} (Gap Trajectory) asks whether newer versions of a family become more secure, or only more capable while the gap remains. 𝐑𝐐 𝟐 \mathbf{RQ_{2}} (Model Tiers) asks whether a compact model is less secure than its flagship, and whether any difference only reflects its lower capability. 𝐑𝐐 𝟑 \mathbf{RQ_{3}} (CWE Evolving Behavior) asks which CWE categories concentrate insecurity and whether each one persists, diverges between families, or regresses as a family evolves. 𝐑𝐐 𝟒 \mathbf{RQ_{4}} (Programming Languages) asks whether the risk of a category depends on the programming language.

paragraphs.en: We selected models from seven families, two proprietary (Google and OpenAI) and five open-weight (Alibaba’s Qwen, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Moonshot AI, and MiniMax). Within each family, we order models into three stages of successive public versions, which form the trajectory of the family. A tier separates the flagship model of a stage from its compact sibling, a smaller checkpoint of disclosed size for the open-weight families, or a cheaper API tier for the proprietary ones, whose sizes are not disclosed. To be able to observe the trajectory of models over time, we constituted a large dataset of 32 models ( Table 1 ), grouped by family and tier and ordered by stage, and indicate which ones reason before answering. Both proprietary families contribute a flagship and a compact model at each stage, 12 models in total. Their newest models, GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna for OpenAI and Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash for Google, power the coding agents of their vendors, Codex and Gemini CLI. As on the open-weight side, our selection thus covers models that developers use for coding in practice. paragraphs.en: We use CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) as the task suite and test oracles. We chose CWEval over other benchmarks for two reasons. First, it evaluates the output of a single model. Frameworks at the repository level, such as SEC-bench ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , evaluate an agent built around a model, whose additional layers prevent isolating the performance of the model itself. Second, its security oracle is dynamic. Benchmarks such as CodeLMSec ( Hajipour et al., 2024 ) and LLMSecEval ( Tony et al., 2023 ) rely on static analysis, which is prone to false positives and cannot show that a flagged weakness manifests at runtime. In CWEval, a sample fails the security oracle only when it behaves insecurely under the attack input, not because its code resembles a vulnerable pattern. CWEval provides 119 tasks covering 31 CWEs in five programming languages (C, C++, Go, JavaScript, and Python). For each task, the model receives a partial source file with the function signature, a comment describing the intended behavior, and the imports the solution may use, and it completes the function body. Each task has two oracles driven by program outcomes. A functional test suite checks the intended behavior, and a security test runs the generated program against an input crafted to trigger the weakness the task probes. The two verdicts are recorded independently, so a sample can be functionally plausible but insecure, or secure but functionally implausible. Apart from the completion budget, the batch interface described in Section 3.3 , and three minor test fixes, we did not modify CWEval’s prompts, oracles, or task set, so that our results remain comparable to prior work on the same benchmark. CWEval offers prompts with and without an instruction to write secure code, and we use only those without it, which reflect ordinary use. Passing a test suite shows that code is functionally plausible, not that it is correct ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , so we call code that passes the functional oracle functionally plausible .

paragraphs.en: Four of the 12 proprietary models, those of the first stage (GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Gemini 1.5 Flash), were already evaluated by CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , and we reuse its results for them. We queried the other eight through OpenRouter ( OpenRouter, 2026 ) , a unified API gateway, using the batch mode of their providers to reduce costs, within an API budget of US$600. This required adapting the generation code of CWEval. We ran the 20 open-weight models with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) (v0.28.0) on a high performance computing cluster, one job per model on a single node with 8 GPUs and 8 CPU cores per GPU. To fit the available GPU memory, we used the official quantized checkpoint of each vendor (mostly in FP8 and in INT4 for the three Kimi checkpoints, and BF16 only where no official quantized version exists), as prior work shows that official low-bit quantization preserves functional benchmark accuracy and pass rates comparable to unquantized baselines ( Afrin et al., 2025 ; Ruiz et al., 2026 ) . Depending on the size of the weights, a job ran on NVIDIA A30 (24 GB), H100 (80 GB), or H200 (141 GB) GPUs, the largest node providing about 1.1 TB of GPU memory and 2.2 TB of host memory. The original completion budget of CWEval, 2,048 tokens, is too short for reasoning models, which spend tokens on reasoning before they answer. We raised it to 65,536 tokens, and to 32,768 tokens for Qwen 3 (235B) and Qwen 3 (30B), whose smaller context window must hold the prompt and the completion. The original budget is adequate for the four reused models, which do not reason before answering. sents.en: To fit the available GPU memory, we used the official quantized checkpoint of each vendor (mostly in FP8 and in INT4 for the three Kimi checkpoints, and BF16 only where no official quantized version exists), as prior work shows that official low-bit quantization preserves functional benchmark accuracy and pass rates comparable to unquantized baselines ( Afrin et al., 2025 ; Ruiz et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 为适应可用的 GPU 显存，我们使用了各厂商提供的官方量化检查点（主要为 FP8 格式；三个 Kimi 检查点使用 INT4 格式；若无官方量化版本，则仅使用 BF16），因为先前的研究已表明，官方低比特量化能够保留与未量化基线模型相当的功能性基准准确率和通过率（Afrin 等人，2025；Ruiz 等人，2026）。

sents.en: Depending on the size of the weights, a job ran on NVIDIA A30 (24 GB), H100 (80 GB), or H200 (141 GB) GPUs, the largest node providing about 1.1 TB of GPU memory and 2.2 TB of host memory.
sents.zh: 根据权重的大小，作业会在 NVIDIA A30（24 GB）、H100（80 GB）或 H200（141 GB）GPU 上运行，其中最大的节点可提供约 1.1 TB GPU 显存和 2.2 TB 主机内存。

sents.en: The original completion budget of CWEval, 2,048 tokens, is too short for reasoning models, which spend tokens on reasoning before they answer.
sents.zh: CWEval 原有的 2,048 个 token 的生成预算对于推理模型而言过短，因为这类模型在回答问题前需要消耗 token 进行推理。

sents.en: We raised it to 65,536 tokens, and to 32,768 tokens for Qwen 3 (235B) and Qwen 3 (30B), whose smaller context window must hold the prompt and the completion.
sents.zh: 我们将该预算提升至 65,536 个 token；对于 Qwen 3（235B）和 Qwen 3（30B），则将其设为 32,768 个 token，因为它们的上下文窗口较小，必须同时容纳提示词和生成内容。

sents.en: The original budget is adequate for the four reused models, which do not reason before answering.
sents.zh: 对于复用的 4 个模型而言，原有预算已足够，因为这些模型在回答问题前无需进行推理。

sents.en: With 100 samples for each of the 119 tasks, the 32 models produce 119 × 100 × 32 = 380,800 119\times 100\times 32=380{,}800 programs.
sents.zh: 针对 119 项任务中的每一项提供 100 个样本，这 32 个模型共产生 119 × 100 × 32 = 380,800 个程序。

paragraphs.en: Following the pass@ k k protocol of Chen et al. (2021) , also adopted by CWEval, we draw n = 100 n=100 samples per task and model. As in CWEval, the sampling temperature is fixed at 0.8 for every model except GPT-5 and GPT-5 mini, whose API accepts only its default temperature of 1. For task i i , let p i p_{i} be the number of samples that pass the functional oracle and b i b_{i} the number that pass both the functional and the security oracle. On top of the unbiased pass@ k k estimator, CWEval defines func@ k k , the probability that at least one of k k samples is functionally plausible, and func-sec@ k k , the probability that at least one is functionally plausible and secure, averaged over the T = 119 T=119 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Chen et al. (2021) 提出的 pass@k 协议（该协议也被 CWEval 采用），我们为每个任务和模型抽取 n = 100 个样本。与 CWEval 的做法一致，除 GPT-5 和 GPT-5 mini 外，所有模型的采样温度均固定为 0.8；因为后两者的 API 仅接受其默认温度 1。对于任务 i，令 p_i 表示通过功能或acles 的样本数量，b_i 表示同时通过功能和安全性 oracles 的样本数量。在无偏的 pass@k 估计量基础上，CWEval 定义了 func@k，即至少有一个 k 个样本在功能上合理的概率；以及 func-sec@k，即至少有一个样本在功能上合理且安全的概率，并对 T = 119 个任务取平均。

paragraphs.en: We compute both metrics for k ∈ { 1 , 10 , 50 } k\in\{1,10,50\} and report k = 1 k=1 and k = 50 k=50 in our results (for k = 10 k=10 see our replication package). k = 1 k=1 reflects the single completion that a developer typically accepts, and k = 50 k=50 estimates whether a model can produce a plausible and secure solution at all, given enough attempts. As in Cannavale et al. (2026) , we define the functionality-security gap Δ sec ​ ( k ) \Delta_{\text{sec}}(k) as the difference between the two metrics, and the Conditional Vulnerability Rate (CVR) as the share of insecure samples among the functionally plausible ones, computed over a group of tasks, such as one CWE or one language, where p p and b b are the sums of p i p_{i} and b i b_{i} over the tasks of the group.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 k ∈ { 1 , 10 , 50 } k\in\{1,10,50\} 计算了这两项指标，并在结果中报告了 k = 1 k=1 和 k = 50 k=50 的情况（关于 k = 10 k=10 的结果，请参见我们的复现包）。k = 1 k=1 反映的是开发者通常会接受的单次完成结果，而 k = 50 k=50 则用于评估模型在足够多次尝试的情况下，是否完全能够生成合理且安全的解决方案。与 Cannavale et al. (2026) 的研究一样，我们将功能-安全差距 Δ sec ​ ( k ) \Delta_{\text{sec}}(k) 定义为这两项指标之间的差异，并将条件漏洞率（CVR）定义为在功能上合理的样本中不安全样本所占的比例。该计算基于一个任务组（例如某个 CWE 或某种语言），其中 p p 和 b b 分别是该任务组中所有任务的 p i p_{i} 和 b i b_{i} 之和。

paragraphs.en: At k = 1 k=1 , Δ sec ​ ( k ) \Delta_{\text{sec}}(k) is the share of samples that are functionally plausible but insecure. For larger k k , it is the expected share of tasks whose k k samples include a functionally plausible solution but no secure one. We report the gap together with func@ k k and func-sec@ k k , so that a change in the gap can be attributed to functionality or to security, and use CVR to identify the vulnerability categories in which the gap concentrates. Both metrics follow the definitions of Cannavale et al. (2026) .

sents.zh: 当 k = 1 时，Δ sec ​ ( k ) 是那些功能上合理但不安全的样本所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: For R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1} , we test whether the gap of a family changes significantly across its three stages. For each flagship model and task, we compute the gap between func@ k k and func-sec@ k k with Equation 2 on that task alone, which yields 119 per-task gaps per model. We then fit one Generalized Estimating Equation (GEE) ( Liang and Zeger, 1986 ) per family and value of k k , with the stage as the only predictor and the first stage as the baseline. For each later stage, the GEE estimates a coefficient β \beta , the difference between the gap Δ sec ​ ( k ) \Delta_{\text{sec}}(k) of that stage and the gap of the first stage. A negative β \beta means that the later stage narrowed the gap, and a positive β \beta means that it widened it. Since all stages are evaluated on the same tasks, we cluster the observations by task with an exchangeable working correlation, so that the significance test accounts for this dependency. We use a Gaussian family with an identity link and consider β \beta significant at p < 0.05 p<0.05 , following the approach of Cannavale et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1}，我们检验一个家族的差距在其三个阶段之间是否存在显著变化。 对于每个旗舰模型和任务，我们仅在该任务上使用公式 2 计算 func@ k k 与 func-sec@ k k 之间的差距，从而得到每个模型每任务的 119 个差距值。 接着，我们为每个家族和 k k 的每个值拟合一个广义估计方程（GEE）（Liang and Zeger, 1986），其中阶段是唯一的预测变量，第一阶段作为基准。 对于每个后续阶段，GEE 会估计出一个系数 β \beta，表示该阶段的差距 Δ sec ​ ( k ) \Delta_{\text{sec}}(k) 与第一阶段的差距之差。 负的 β \beta 表示后续阶段缩小了差距，而正的 β \beta 则表示扩大了差距。 由于所有阶段都在相同任务上进行评估，我们通过任务对观测值进行聚类，并使用可交换的工作相关性，以便显著性检验能够考虑到这种依赖性。 我们采用高斯分布族和恒等链接，并遵循 Cannavale et al. (2026) 的方法，在 p < 0.05 p<0.05 时认为 β \beta 是显著的。

paragraphs.en: For R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2} , we use the same approach to compare the flagship and the compact model of a stage, with one GEE per family, stage, and value of k k . The tier replaces the stage as the predictor, with the flagship as the baseline. Here, β \beta is the gap of the compact model minus the gap of the flagship, so a positive β \beta means that the compact model has the wider gap.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2}，我们采用相同的方法比较某一阶段中旗舰模型与紧凑型模型，每个家族、每个阶段以及每个 k k 值对应一个 GEE。 层级取代了阶段作为预测器，而旗舰模型则作为基准。 此处，β \beta 是紧凑型模型的差距减去旗舰模型的差距，因此 β \beta 为正值表示紧凑型模型的差距更大。

paragraphs.en: For R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} , we compute the CVR per model and CWE category and examine how it changes across the stages of each family, focusing on the 16 categories with the highest mean CVR. Similar to Cannavale et al. (2026) , we classify a category as a persistent blind spot if its CVR stays high at every stage, as an evolutionary divergence if some families reduce their CVR while others stagnate, and as a regression anomaly if a later stage is worse than an earlier one. For persistent blind spots and regression anomalies, we manually inspect functionally plausible but insecure samples to identify the construct that makes the code insecure.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3}，我们按模型和 CWE 类别计算 CVR，并研究其在每个家族各阶段的变化情况，重点关注平均 CVR 最高的 16 个类别。与 Cannavale 等人（2026）的研究类似，如果一个类别的 CVR 在所有阶段都保持较高水平，则将其归类为“持续盲点”；如果某些家族的 CVR 有所降低，而其他家族则停滞不前，则归类为“演化分歧”；如果某个后续阶段的 CVR 比早期阶段更差，则归类为“退化异常”。对于持续盲点和退化异常，我们会手动检查功能上合理但存在安全问题的样本，以识别导致代码不安全的构造。

paragraphs.en: For R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} , we compute the CVR per programming language, pooled over all models for each CWE category and pooled over all categories for each model. paragraphs.en: Across all families, a gap between func@ k k and func-sec@ k k persists at every stage (see Figure 1 ). At the newest stage, it ranges from 0.13 (GPT-5.6 Sol) to 0.28 (Gemini 3.1 Pro) at k = 1 k=1 . At k = 50 k=50 the gap is smaller in every family, because with more attempts more tasks obtain at least one sample that is both functionally plausible and secure, so both metrics approach their ceiling. Because functional plausibility starts high in most families and grows only moderately, the gap evolves mostly with security. Google is the exception. Its func@1 rises from 0.69 (Gemini 1.5 Pro) to 0.94 (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and its func-sec@1 by about as much, and although Google gains the most security at k = 1 k=1 , its gap barely changes. In OpenAI, by contrast, func-sec@1 rises several times as much as func@1, which gives the largest narrowing at k = 1 k=1 . At k = 50 k=50 , where Google’s functional plausibility has less room to grow, its narrowing becomes clear as well. This trend indicates that a gain in security narrows the gap only when it outpaces the gain in functional plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有模型系列中，func@ k k 和 func-sec@ k k 之间的差距在每个阶段都持续存在（见图 1）。 在最新阶段，当 k = 1 k=1 时，该差距范围从 0.13（GPT-5.6 Sol）到 0.28（Gemini 3.1 Pro）。 当 k = 50 k=50 时，每个模型系列中的差距都更小，因为尝试次数越多，越多的任务能够获得至少一个既功能合理又安全的样本，因此两项指标都会接近其上限。 由于大多数模型系列的功能合理性初始值较高且仅适度增长，因此该差距的变化主要取决于安全性。Google 是例外。 Google 的 func@1 从 0.69（Gemini 1.5 Pro）上升到 0.94（Gemini 3.1 Pro），其 func-sec@1 也大致上升了相同幅度；尽管 Google 在 k = 1 k=1 时安全性提升最大，但其差距几乎没有变化。 相比之下，在 OpenAI 中，func-sec@1 的增长幅度是 func@1 的数倍，这使得 k = 1 k=1 时的差距缩小最为显著。 当 k = 50 k=50 时，Google 的功能合理性已无太多提升空间，此时其差距缩小的趋势也变得明显。 这一趋势表明，安全性的提升只有在超越功能合理性的提升时，才会使两者之间的差距缩小。

paragraphs.en: The statistical results highlight two aspects. First, a compact model is not always less secure than its flagship, and second, the gap for compact models also shrinks as families evolve. The compact model Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches the same func-sec@ k k as its flagship Gemini 3.1 Pro in Figure 1 , and its gap at k = 1 k=1 is significantly narrower. In 13 of the 22 overall comparisons, including every Qwen comparison at k = 1 k=1 , the two tiers do not differ significantly, and the direction of these differences is mixed, with the gap of the compact model sometimes wider and sometimes narrower than that of its flagship. When tiers do differ significantly, however, the compact model has the wider gap in eight of the nine cases. At k = 50 k=50 , the compact models of Google, OpenAI, and Qwen all have a significantly wider gap than their flagship at the first stage, but only OpenAI still shows this difference at the newest stage. OpenAI does not follow this convergence. Its two tiers are close at the middle stage, yet GPT-5.6 Luna has a significantly wider gap than GPT-5.6 Sol at both values of k k , because the compact model loses security from GPT-5 mini to GPT-5.6 Luna while the flagship holds steady, in line with the regression across categories that R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} reports for this model. DeepSeek shows the same pattern at its newest stage, significantly so at k = 1 k=1 . OpenAI and DeepSeek, the two families that narrow the gap most consistently in R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1} , are also the two whose compact model has the wider gap at the newest stage.
paragraphs.zh: 统计结果凸显了两个方面的情况。 首先，紧凑型模型并不总是比其旗舰型号安全性更低；其次，随着模型家族的发展，紧凑型模型与旗舰型号之间的差距也在缩小。 在图1中，紧凑型模型 Gemini 3.7 Flash 的 func-sec@ k k 值与其旗舰型号 Gemini 3.1 Pro 相同，且当 k = 1 k=1 时，其差距明显更小。 在总共22次比较中的13次（包括所有 k = 1 k=1 时的 Qwen 比较）中，这两个层级并无显著差异，且差异的方向也不一致：紧凑型模型与旗舰型号的差距有时更大，有时则更小。 然而，当两个层级存在显著差异时，在9种情况中有8种情况下，紧凑型模型的差距更大。 在 k = 50 k=50 时，Google、OpenAI 和 Qwen 的紧凑型模型在第一阶段与各自旗舰型号的差距均明显更大，但到了最新阶段，只有 OpenAI 仍表现出这种差异。 OpenAI 并未遵循这种收敛趋势。 其两个层级在中段阶段较为接近，但在 k 的两个取值下，GPT-5.6 Luna 的差距均显著大于 GPT-5.6 Sol，这是因为从 GPT-5 mini 到 GPT-5.6 Luna，紧凑型模型的安全性有所下降，而旗舰型号则保持稳定；这与 R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} 对该模型跨类别的回归报告一致。 DeepSeek 在其最新阶段也表现出相同的模式，尤其在 k = 1 k=1 时差异显著。 OpenAI 和 DeepSeek 是在 R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1} 中差距缩小最稳定的两个模型家族，但在最新阶段，它们也是紧凑型模型与旗舰型号差距更大的两个模型家族。

paragraphs.en: Cross-site scripting (CWE-79) divides the open-weight families, while both proprietary families end well below where they started. The OpenAI flagship brings its rate to zero and Google cuts it substantially, and so do the DeepSeek and MiniMax flagships, the latter almost as far as OpenAI. Qwen, in contrast, stays at the maximum in both tiers, Z.ai improves only slightly, and Moonshot even gets worse. CWE-22 (path traversal) divides the families in a similar way. The OpenAI and DeepSeek flagships improve strongly, while every other newest model stays at or above one half. XPath injection (CWE-643) separates the families even more clearly. OpenAI resolves it in both tiers, and the Moonshot and Z.ai flagships come close, while DeepSeek and the Google flagship keep most of their functionally plausible samples insecure. None of these splits follows the line between proprietary and open-weight families. CWE-347 (improper verification of cryptographic signature) is the clearest case where it does. All proprietary trajectories improve on it, the compact models most of all, whereas no open-weight trajectory shows a comparable gain.

paragraphs.en: CWE-400 (uncontrolled resource consumption) regresses in the flagships of Google, OpenAI, and DeepSeek, and manual inspection shows one shared cause. The earlier models solve the task with a plain text search, whereas the newest ones treat the caller’s search pattern as a regular expression and match it against the caller’s own text, so an attacker controls both sides of the match. The newest proprietary models also regress on categories they had already handled well. OpenAI is the only family whose newest models are worse than its first ones on out-of-bounds read (CWE-125), rising from zero in GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini, while the open-weight families that spike on this category at their middle stage return below their starting point. On integer overflow (CWE-190), Gemini 3.1 Pro rises from almost zero in Gemini 2.5 Pro to the highest rate of any newest model, and the three highest rates among the newest models all belong to proprietary ones. GPT-5.6 Luna is less secure than GPT-5 mini on most of the 16 categories, at least four of them by a wide margin, and Gemini 3.1 Pro brings back eval injection (CWE-95), which Gemini 2.5 Pro had almost eliminated. Other regressions are transient. Qwen’s middle stage, Qwen 3 Coder (480B), a model specialized for code, is clearly its least secure flagship on six of the 16 categories, and the newest stage recovers on all six. Deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502) is one of these six, but in other families the regression persists. The newest DeepSeek models of both tiers are insecure on almost every functionally plausible sample, the compact tier of Google starts fully secure and never returns to it, and Z.ai and MiniMax regress to a lesser degree.
paragraphs.zh: 在谷歌、OpenAI 和 DeepSeek 的旗舰模型中，CWE-400（不受控制的资源消耗）问题出现倒退，而人工检查显示其存在一个共同原因。 早期模型通过简单的文本搜索完成任务，而最新模型则将调用者的搜索模式视为正则表达式，并与调用者自身的文本进行匹配，因此攻击者可以控制匹配的双方。 最新的专有模型在原本已能良好处理的类别上也出现了性能倒退。 OpenAI 是唯一一个其最新模型在越界读取（CWE-125）问题上表现不如早期模型的系列：GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o mini 的此类问题率从零开始上升，而在此类别中期表现突出的开源权重系列则回落至初始水平以下。 在整数溢出（CWE-190）问题上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 的问题率从 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的近零水平上升至所有最新模型中的最高值，且最新模型中问题率最高的三个均属于专有模型。 在 16 个类别中的大多数上，GPT-5.6 Luna 的安全性低于 GPT-5 mini，其中至少四个类别存在显著差距；同时，Gemini 3.1 Pro 重新引入了评估注入（CWE-95）问题，而该问题在 Gemini 2.5 Pro 中几乎已被消除。 其他性能倒退现象是暂时性的。 Qwen 的中期模型 Qwen 3 Coder（480B）是一个专门用于代码的模型，在 16 个类别中的六个上明显是其安全性最差的旗舰模型，而最新阶段则在这六个类别上全部恢复。 不可信数据的反序列化（CWE-502）是这六个类别之一，但在其他系列中，这一问题仍然持续存在。 DeepSeek 两个层级的最新模型在几乎所有功能合理的样本上均存在安全问题；谷歌的紧凑型层级最初完全安全且从未回归到不安全状态；Z.ai 和 MiniMax 的倒退程度则相对较小。

For archive extraction, C and C++ samples reproduce the extraction example of the prompt, which has no path check, and Python samples call extractall without a filter, while Go samples, with neither, mostly write their own containment check. sents.zh: Python 库拒绝在没有明确指定算法的情况下解码令牌，因此几乎所有的 Python 样本都将算法固定为 algorithms=["HS256"]。

sents.en: CWE-22 is clearly lower in Go.

sents.en: For archive extraction, C and C++ samples reproduce the extraction example of the prompt, which has no path check, and Python samples call extractall without a filter, while Go samples, with neither, mostly write their own containment check.
sents.zh: 在解压存档方面，C 和 C++ 样本复现了提示中的解压示例，该示例未进行路径检查；Python 样本调用 extractall 时未使用过滤器；而 Go 样本既没有这些措施，但大多自行编写了内容限制检查。

paragraphs.en: CWE-502 and CWE-95 are tested only in Python and JavaScript, and both split the two languages. CWE-502 reaches 0.80 in Python and 0.00 in JavaScript. In the inspected models, Python samples mostly reuse the unsafe Loader of PyYAML that the prompt imports, and every sample that passes it to yaml.load is insecure, while the one sample in five that calls yaml.safe_load instead is always secure. JavaScript samples use a YAML loader that is safe by default. CWE-95 reverses the order. Both languages fail by evaluating the raw input, but Python samples usually parse the expression through its syntax tree, while JavaScript, with no expression parser in its standard library, mostly relies on eval or new Function .

paragraphs.en: C combines a high starting point with the smallest improvement. In Google, Qwen, Z.ai, and MiniMax, C shows the smallest decrease of the five core languages between the first and the newest stage, and its distance from the other languages grows accordingly. OpenAI is the opposite case, with C improving the most and its newest models having the smallest difference between languages of any newest stage. The resistance of C concentrates on CWE-22 and CWE-79. On CWE-79, the Flash models of Google bring the rate close to zero in Go and Python, while every functionally plausible C sample of Gemini 3.7 Flash remains insecure. Inspection of the insecure CWE-79 samples finds no escaping, as in strcat(message, username) . Escaping is least frequent in C, where the model must write its own function, whereas Python and Go need a single call.
paragraphs.zh: C 兼具较高的起点和最小的改进幅度。 在 Google、Qwen、Z.ai 和 MiniMax 中，C 在最初阶段与最新阶段之间五种核心语言中的下降幅度最小，因此它与其他语言的差距也相应增大。 OpenAI 的情况则恰恰相反：C 的改进最大，其最新模型在各语言间的差异是所有最新阶段中最小的。 C 的防御薄弱点主要集中在 CWE-22 和 CWE-79 上。 在 CWE-79 方面，Google 的 Flash 模型将 Go 和 Python 中的漏洞率降至接近零，而 Gemini 3.7 Flash 中所有功能上看似合理的 C 样本仍存在安全漏洞。 对存在 CWE-79 安全漏洞的样本进行检查后发现，并未出现字符串溢出问题，例如 strcat(message, username) 的情况。 C 中的字符串溢出频率最低，因为模型必须自行编写相关函数，而 Python 和 Go 只需一次函数调用即可。

paragraphs.en: Functional plausibility is high from the first stage in our results, yet no family closes the functionality-security gap. Technical debt can harm the security of software ( Recupito et al., 2024 ) , and security debt has been found to accumulate quickly in LLM-based software ( Qi et al., 2024 ) . Generated code adds to this debt whenever it passes its functional tests but remains exploitable, and in our results this affects weaknesses of high practical relevance. CWE-79, first in the CWE Top 25 ( MITRE, 2026b ) , stays at the maximum in both Qwen tiers, CWE-22, sixth, stays at or above one half in every newest model except GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek V4 Pro, and CWE-502, fifteenth, regresses in several families. Security therefore has to be evaluated alongside functionality instead of being assumed from it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果显示，从第一阶段开始功能合理性就很高，但没有任何一个模型族能够弥合功能性与安全性之间的差距。 技术债务可能损害软件的安全性（Recupito 等，2024），而安全债务则被发现会在使用大语言模型的软件中迅速累积（Qi 等，2024）。 每当生成的代码通过功能测试但仍然存在可被利用的漏洞时，就会增加这种债务；在我们的结果中，这种情况影响了具有高度实际重要性的弱点。 CWE-79 位列 CWE Top 25 之首（MITRE，2026b），在两个 Qwen 层级中都保持在最高水平；CWE-22 排名第六，在所有最新模型中除 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 外，其值均保持在二分之一或以上；而 CWE-502 排名第十五，在多个模型族中出现了性能下降。 因此，安全性必须与功能性一并进行评估，而不能仅凭功能性来推断。

paragraphs.en: Vendors present a new model mainly through its functional results. Each open-weight flagship we evaluate was among the strongest open-weight models on SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , or HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) when it appeared, yet none closes the gap. Our results show why a functional score cannot stand in for security. Gemini 3.1 Pro, for instance, is both more capable and more secure than Gemini 1.5 Pro, yet its gap barely changes ( R ​ Q 1 RQ_{1} ). Elgedawy et al. (2024) observe the same across three observation phases, where the platforms they study reach full functionality while their vulnerability counts do not follow. Vendors should report func-sec@ k k and the gap next to the functional scores of every new version.
paragraphs.zh: 供应商主要通过模型的功能表现来展示其新模型。我们评估的每个开源旗舰模型，在发布时都是 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）、LiveCodeBench（Jain 等人，2025）或 HumanEval（Chen 等人，2021）上最强的开源模型之一，但没有任何一个能够弥合这一差距。我们的研究结果表明，为何功能得分无法替代安全性评估。例如，Gemini 3.1 Pro 在能力与安全性上都优于 Gemini 1.5 Pro，但其性能差距几乎未发生变化（R​Q₁ RQ_{1}）。Elgedawy 等人（2024）在三个观察阶段中也观察到了相同现象：他们所研究的平台虽已实现完整功能，但漏洞数量却并未同步减少。供应商应在每个新版本的得分中，同时报告 func-sec@ k k 指标及其与基准的差距。

paragraphs.en: A narrowing gap does not mean that every weakness improves with it. OpenAI narrows the gap most consistently, yet its newest models are the only ones worse than their first on CWE-125, eighth in the CWE Top 25. DeepSeek, which also narrows its gap consistently, regresses on CWE-502 and CWE-400. An aggregate score hides such losses, and a family that improves on average can still become less secure on an individual weakness. Before publishing, vendors should compare new models with their predecessors per CWE (see Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 差距缩小并不意味着每个弱点都会随之得到改善。 OpenAI 的差距缩小最为稳定，但其最新模型在 CWE-125（CWE Top 25 中的第八项）上表现反而不如其首个版本。 DeepSeek 的差距同样持续缩小，但在 CWE-502 和 CWE-400 上的表现却出现了倒退。 综合得分会掩盖这类性能下降，一个平均表现提升的模型系列，仍可能在某个具体弱点上安全性降低。 在发布前，供应商应按每个 CWE 将新模型与其旧版本进行比较（参见图 2）。

paragraphs.en: CWE-117 and CWE-113 remain insecure in almost every family, stage, and tier we evaluate. This is not a limit of capability. GPT-5 secures more than half of its functionally plausible samples on CWE-113, and the secure version differs from the insecure one by a single step, removing line breaks from the input. Security instruction tuning, as in SafeCoder ( He et al., 2024 ) , raises the share of secure code for the weakness types in its training data while preserving functionality. Vendors can add CWE-117 and CWE-113 to such data, which targets the two categories that no family resolves on its own as it evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们评估的几乎每个模型系列、阶段和层级中，CWE-117 和 CWE-113 仍然存在安全漏洞。 这并非能力上的限制。 GPT-5 在超过一半的功能合理样本中实现了 CWE-113 的安全防护，其安全版本与不安全版本仅相差一步操作：从输入中移除换行符。 安全指令调优（如 SafeCoder (He et al., 2024) 中的方法）可以在保持功能性的同时，提高训练数据中这些漏洞类型对应的安全代码比例。 供应商可以将 CWE-117 和 CWE-113 添加到此类数据中，从而针对这两个在模型演进过程中没有任何模型系列能够自行解决的类别进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Over a full trajectory, upgrading pays off. Every family narrows the gap significantly by its newest stage, and func-sec@1 of every flagship is higher at the newest stage than at the first. A single step, however, can go the other way. Qwen, Z.ai, and Moonshot widen the gap at their middle stage, and GPT-5.6 Luna is less secure than GPT-5 mini on most of the 16 categories, and a developer who upgraded to these models lost security. Prior work observes the same for other properties, where a newer version of a model improves on some of them and gets worse on others ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Developers should therefore not treat an upgrade as a security improvement by default, and should rerun their security checks whenever they switch versions.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个轨迹中，升级是有益的。 每个家族在其最新阶段都显著缩小了差距，并且每个旗舰模型在最新阶段的 func-sec@1 值都高于初始阶段。 然而，单一步骤也可能导致相反的结果。 Qwen、Z.ai 和 Moonshot 在其中间阶段扩大了差距，而 GPT-5.6 Luna 在 16 个类别中的大多数安全性都不如 GPT-5 mini，升级到这些模型的开发者因此失去了安全性。 先前的研究在其他属性上也观察到了相同现象：模型的新版本在某些属性上有所改进，而在另一些属性上则表现更差（Chen et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2026）。 因此，开发者不应默认将升级视为安全性的提升，并且在每次切换版本时都应重新运行安全性检查。

paragraphs.en: Choosing the compact model of a family is not only a decision about cost and speed. When the tiers differ significantly, the compact model almost always has the wider gap, and its functional behavior may give no hint of it, as DeepSeek V4 Flash shows ( R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2} ). This penalty shrinks as families evolve, and Gemini 3.7 Flash even has a narrower gap than Gemini 3.1 Pro at k = 1 k=1 . Developers should thus compare the security of both tiers of the version they adopt instead of inferring it from the tier.
paragraphs.zh: 为某个系列选择紧凑型模型，不仅是一个关于成本和速度的决策。 当不同层级差异显著时，紧凑型模型的差距几乎总是更大，而其行为表现可能对此毫无提示，正如 DeepSeek V4 Flash 所示（R ​ Q 2 RQ_{2}）。 随着系列的发展，这种性能损失会逐渐缩小，Gemini 3.7 Flash 在 k = 1 k=1 时的差距甚至比 Gemini 3.1 Pro 更小。 因此，开发者应该比较所采用版本中两个层级的安全性，而不是根据层级本身推断其安全性。

paragraphs.en: Which families narrow their gap significantly depends on the number of attempts. Google narrows significantly by its newest stage only at k = 50 k=50 , and the widening of Qwen, Z.ai, and Moonshot at the middle stage appears at k = 50 k=50 but not at k = 1 k=1 . A comparison of only the first and the newest version would show Qwen, Z.ai, and Moonshot narrowing and miss the widening in between, so longitudinal studies need more than two versions per family. paragraphs.en: The regressions we observe, in the gap at the middle stage and in individual weakness types, leave open why security is lost between versions. Fine-tuning on benign data can weaken the safety alignment of an LLM unevenly across categories ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , and Liu et al. (2026) find that safety fine-tuning improves resistance to jailbreaks while degrading robustness on classification tasks. Our manual inspection points to one concrete mechanism, since the newest flagships of three families replace a plain text search with a regular expression built from the pattern of the caller (CWE-400). Whether the training of newer models favors such general constructs, and how to prevent the resulting regressions, remains to be studied.

paragraphs.en: First, our results refine their central finding that models become smarter but not safer. Across our families, func-sec@1 rises from the first to the newest stage in every family, so newer models do become safer in absolute terms. They become safer in proportion to their capability only when their security grows faster than their functional plausibility, which Google, with the largest gain in security at k = 1 k=1 , shows does not always happen.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们的研究结果对其核心发现进行了修正：模型变得更智能，但并未变得更安全。 在我们研究的各个模型系列中，func-sec@1 从首个阶段到最新阶段均持续上升，因此较新的模型在绝对意义上确实变得更安全了。 只有当模型的安全性增长速度快于其功能合理性时，它们才会与能力成比例地变得更安全；而谷歌（在 k = 1 时安全性提升最大）的实例表明，这种情况并非总是发生。

paragraphs.en: Second, our results disagree with theirs on open-weight models. Cannavale et al. (2026) report a clean split, in which GPT and Claude narrow the gap significantly while Llama shows no significant movement, and they read CWE-22 and CWE-79 as weaknesses that proprietary models resolve and Llama does not. In our results, openness does not separate the families. Every open-weight family narrows the gap significantly by its newest stage for at least one value of k k , and DeepSeek, significant at both stages for k = 50 k=50 , matches OpenAI there. Google, in turn, does not narrow its gap significantly at its newest stage for k = 1 k=1 , and Gemini 3.1 Pro keeps a gap of 0.28, close to the 0.296 they report for Llama 4 Scout. The same holds per weakness. On CWE-79, Qwen stays at the maximum as Llama does, while DeepSeek and MiniMax reduce their rate sharply, and on CWE-22 both Google models of the newest stage keep most plausible samples insecure, while DeepSeek V4 Pro improves strongly. For us, only CWE-347 separates proprietary from open-weight families.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们在开放权重模型上的结果与他们不一致。Cannavale 等人（2026）报告了一种清晰的划分：GPT 和 Claude 显著缩小了差距，而 Llama 则没有表现出明显变化；他们将 CWE-22 和 CWE-79 视为专有模型能够解决但 Llama 无法解决的弱点。在我们的结果中，开放性并未将不同模型家族区分开来。每个开放权重模型家族在其最新阶段都至少对某个 k 值显著缩小了差距；对于 k = 50 的情况，DeepSeek 在两个阶段均表现出显著性，从而与 OpenAI 的结果一致。而 Google 则不同：当 k = 1 时，其最新阶段的差距并未显著缩小，Gemini 3.1 Pro 仍保持 0.28 的差距，接近他们报告的 Llama 4 Scout 的 0.296。按具体弱点来看也是如此。在 CWE-79 上，Qwen 与 Llama 一样保持在最高水平，而 DeepSeek 和 MiniMax 则大幅降低了其发生率；在 CWE-22 上，Google 的最新阶段模型仍使大多数最可信的样本存在安全风险，而 DeepSeek V4 Pro 则有显著改善。对我们而言，只有 CWE-347 能够将专有模型家族与开放权重模型家族区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We attribute this difference mainly to the choice of families. A single lineage cannot represent the open-weight field, and Cannavale et al. (2026) themselves name DeepSeek among the models to which their findings may not generalize. The path of Llama also resembles the one we observe for Qwen, Z.ai, and Moonshot. Its security drops at Llama 3.3 before recovering, a widening at an intermediate version like the one that becomes significant in our results only at k = 50 k=50 , so the stagnation they report may hide a similar path.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一差异主要归因于所选模型家族的不同。单一谱系无法代表开放权重领域，而 Cannavale 等人（2026）自己也指出，DeepSeek 属于其研究结论可能无法推广到的模型之一。Llama 的发展路径也与我们在 Qwen、Z.ai 和 Moonshot 中观察到的情况相似。其安全性在 Llama 3.3 时出现下降，之后才恢复；在某个中间版本中出现了性能扩大现象，但在我们的结果中，这一现象直到 k = 50 k=50 时才变得显著。因此，他们报告的性能停滞可能掩盖了类似的发展路径。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the two studies differ on programming languages. Cannavale et al. (2026) find the trajectories of the gap uniform across the five languages and conclude that language is not a primary discriminator. At the level of individual weaknesses, our results show the opposite. The same CWE carries very different risk in different languages, as CWE-347 in Go and Python shows, and C leads in most models, with a lead that grows in four families. A uniform trajectory of the gap per language can thus hide strong differences between languages at the level of individual weaknesses. Taken together, the two studies agree on the persistence of the gap and its blind spots. Moreover, our study shows that newer models do become safer in absolute terms, that openness does not decide how a family evolves, that compact models can be a viable alternative, and that the risk of a weakness depends on the programming language.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，这两项研究在编程语言方面存在差异。Cannavale 等人（2026）发现，差距的变化趋势在这五种语言中保持一致，并得出结论：语言并非主要区分因素。但在具体弱点的层面，我们的研究结果却显示相反的情况。同一 CWE 在不同语言中的风险差异显著，例如 CWE-347 在 Go 和 Python 中的表现；此外，C 语言在大多数模型中均处于领先地位，且这一领先优势在四个语言家族中进一步扩大。因此，每种语言中差距的统一变化趋势可能掩盖了具体弱点层面不同语言之间的显著差异。综合来看，这两项研究都认同该差距的持续存在及其盲点。此外，我们的研究还表明：较新的模型在绝对意义上确实变得更安全；开放性并不决定一个语言家族如何演变；紧凑型模型可以成为可行的替代方案；某种弱点的风险取决于所使用的编程语言。

paragraphs.en: (Data Contamination) CWEval predates most models we evaluate, so its tasks may have entered their training data. This could inflate the improvement across stages, but it cannot explain the persistent weaknesses and regressions: even the newest models remain near the maximum CVR on CWE-113 and CWE-117 and regress on categories their predecessors had already handled ( R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} ). (Prompt Engineering) We did not alter the prompts of CWEval, which keeps our results comparable with prior work and measures the default behavior of the models, the one developers get when they leave security implicit ( Elahi et al., 2011 ) . Security-aware prompts may yield a smaller gap, which we leave for future work. (Model Configurations) We used consistent parameter configurations throughout all experiments when possible. We drew 100 samples per task and model at the CWEval temperature of T = 0.8 T=0.8 , except for GPT-5 and GPT-5 mini, whose API only accepts T = 1 T=1 . For the four proprietary models of the first stage, we reuse the CWEval results (same prompts, oracles, and temperature), since Google no longer serves Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash. Open-weight models ran in the official quantized precision that vendors publish for deployment. (Manual Inspection) The analyses for R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} and R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} are fully automated. Manual inspection by two co-authors served only to explain the identified patterns, and we report a cause only when it recurs across the inspected samples. (Differences in Model Stages) Stages within a family also differ in size, code specialization, and reasoning. We keep these differences as part of how vendors evolve their models, and use the thinking variant of Kimi K2 so that all Moonshot stages reason. The observed gap does not simply follow size: at k = 50 k=50 , it narrows significantly between DeepSeek V3 and V3.2, with equal size. Since the intervals between versions are irregular (5 to 27 months per trajectory), we describe the change per version, which matches how developers adopt new models.
paragraphs.zh: （数据污染）CWEval 的问世早于我们评估的大多数模型，因此其任务可能已被纳入这些模型的训练数据中。 这可能会夸大各阶段之间的改进幅度，但无法解释持续存在的弱点和性能倒退：即便是最新的模型，在 CWE-113 和 CWE-117 上的 CVR 值仍接近最大值，并且在先代模型已能处理的类别上出现了性能倒退（ R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} ）。 （提示工程）我们没有修改 CWEval 的提示词，这使得我们的结果能够与先前的研究保持可比性，并衡量模型的默认行为——即开发者在安全相关任务未明确提及时所得到的表现（ Elahi et al., 2011 ）。 具备安全意识的提示词可能会缩小这一差距，但我们将此问题留待未来研究。 （模型配置）在所有实验中，只要可能，我们都使用了统一的参数配置。 对于每个任务和模型，我们在 CWEval 的温度值 T = 0.8 T=0.8 下抽取了 100 个样本，但 GPT-5 和 GPT-5 mini 的 API 仅接受 T = 1 T=1 。 对于第一阶段的四款专有模型，我们复用了 CWEval 的结果（相同的提示词、预言机和温度值），因为 Google 已不再提供 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Flash。 开放权重模型以厂商发布的官方量化精度运行。 （人工检查）对 R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} 和 R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} 的分析完全自动化。 两名合著者进行的人工检查仅用于解释已识别的模式，并且只有当某种原因在多个受检样本中重复出现时，我们才会报告该原因。 （模型阶段差异）同一系列模型的不同阶段在规模、代码特化和推理能力上也存在差异。 我们将这些差异视为厂商演进模型的一部分，并使用 Kimi K2 的“思考”变体，以确保所有 Moonshot 阶段都具备推理能力。 观察到的差距并不单纯由模型规模决定：在 k = 50 k=50 时，尽管 DeepSeek V3 和 V3.2 规模相同，但两者之间的差距显著缩小。 由于各版本之间的时间间隔不规律（每条发展路径为 5 至 27 个月），我们按每个版本描述其变化，这与开发者采用新模型的方式一致。

sents.en: (Data Contamination) CWEval predates most models we evaluate, so its tasks may have entered their training data.
sents.zh: （数据污染）CWEval 的问世早于我们评估的大多数模型，因此其任务可能已被纳入这些模型的训练数据中。

sents.en: This could inflate the improvement across stages, but it cannot explain the persistent weaknesses and regressions: even the newest models remain near the maximum CVR on CWE-113 and CWE-117 and regress on categories their predecessors had already handled ( R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} ).
sents.zh: 这可能会夸大各阶段之间的改进幅度，但无法解释持续存在的弱点和性能倒退：即便是最新的模型，在 CWE-113 和 CWE-117 上的 CVR 值仍接近最大值，并且在先代模型已能处理的类别上出现了性能倒退（ R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} ）。

sents.en: (Prompt Engineering) We did not alter the prompts of CWEval, which keeps our results comparable with prior work and measures the default behavior of the models, the one developers get when they leave security implicit ( Elahi et al., 2011 ) .
sents.zh: （提示工程）我们没有修改 CWEval 的提示词，这使得我们的结果能够与先前的研究保持可比性，并衡量模型的默认行为——即开发者在安全相关任务未明确提及时所得到的表现（ Elahi et al., 2011 ）。

sents.zh: 具备安全意识的提示词可能会缩小这一差距，但我们将此问题留待未来研究。

sents.en: (Model Configurations) We used consistent parameter configurations throughout all experiments when possible.
sents.zh: （模型配置）在所有实验中，只要可能，我们都使用了统一的参数配置。

sents.en: We drew 100 samples per task and model at the CWEval temperature of T = 0.8 T=0.8 , except for GPT-5 and GPT-5 mini, whose API only accepts T = 1 T=1 .
sents.zh: 对于每个任务和模型，我们在 CWEval 的温度值 T = 0.8 T=0.8 下抽取了 100 个样本，但 GPT-5 和 GPT-5 mini 的 API 仅接受 T = 1 T=1 。

sents.en: For the four proprietary models of the first stage, we reuse the CWEval results (same prompts, oracles, and temperature), since Google no longer serves Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash.
sents.zh: 对于第一阶段的四款专有模型，我们复用了 CWEval 的结果（相同的提示词、预言机和温度值），因为 Google 已不再提供 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Flash。

sents.en: Open-weight models ran in the official quantized precision that vendors publish for deployment.
sents.zh: 开放权重模型以厂商发布的官方量化精度运行。

sents.en: (Manual Inspection) The analyses for R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} and R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} are fully automated.
sents.zh: （人工检查）对 R ​ Q 3 RQ_{3} 和 R ​ Q 4 RQ_{4} 的分析完全自动化。

sents.en: Manual inspection by two co-authors served only to explain the identified patterns, and we report a cause only when it recurs across the inspected samples.
sents.zh: 两名合著者进行的人工检查仅用于解释已识别的模式，并且只有当某种原因在多个受检样本中重复出现时，我们才会报告该原因。

sents.en: (Differences in Model Stages) Stages within a family also differ in size, code specialization, and reasoning.
sents.zh: （模型阶段差异）同一系列模型的不同阶段在规模、代码特化和推理能力上也存在差异。

sents.en: We keep these differences as part of how vendors evolve their models, and use the thinking variant of Kimi K2 so that all Moonshot stages reason.
sents.zh: 我们将这些差异视为厂商演进模型的一部分，并使用 Kimi K2 的“思考”变体，以确保所有 Moonshot 阶段都具备推理能力。

sents.en: The observed gap does not simply follow size: at k = 50 k=50 , it narrows significantly between DeepSeek V3 and V3.2, with equal size.
sents.zh: 观察到的差距并不单纯由模型规模决定：在 k = 50 k=50 时，尽管 DeepSeek V3 和 V3.2 规模相同，但两者之间的差距显著缩小。

sents.en: Since the intervals between versions are irregular (5 to 27 months per trajectory), we describe the change per version, which matches how developers adopt new models.
sents.zh: 由于各版本之间的时间间隔不规律（每条发展路径为 5 至 27 个月），我们按每个版本描述其变化，这与开发者采用新模型的方式一致。

paragraphs.en: (Model Families) Our findings may not generalize to other model families, CWEs, or programming languages. We omit Claude and Llama because prior work already covers their trajectories on CWEval ( Cannavale et al., 2026 ) , and we relate our findings to theirs in our discussion. (Model Integrations) CWEval tasks ask for a single function tested in isolation, whereas real projects embed generated code in larger codebases. Such tasks are required to isolate the output of a model (Section 3.2 ); whether a larger context helps avoid the observed weaknesses remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: （模型家族）我们的研究结果可能无法推广到其他模型家族、CWE 或编程语言。 我们未包含 Claude 和 Llama，因为先前的研究已经涵盖了它们在 CWEval 上的发展轨迹（Cannavale 等人，2026），并且我们在讨论中会将我们的研究结果与它们的结果进行比较。 （模型集成）CWEval 任务要求对单个函数进行独立测试，而实际项目则将生成的代码嵌入到更大的代码库中。 此类任务是必要的，以便隔离模型的输出（第 3.2 节）；至于更长的上下文是否有助于避免所观察到的弱点，仍属于未来的研究课题。

paragraphs.en: (Number of Tasks) Several CWEs rest on only one or two tasks, so per-CWE results may reflect task-specific properties. We therefore treat them as observations on the benchmark tasks, not as general claims about the CWE. To reduce the risk of spurious effects, we manually inspected the regressions and found that they share a concrete pattern across models, such as building a regular expression from the pattern of the caller for CWE-400. Cells without any functionally plausible sample are hatched in our figures, and none of our claims rests on a cell with few such samples. (Aggregate Analysis) Since each task appears at every stage and tier, we fit a GEE clustered by task. With 119 clusters, its coefficient estimates and cluster-robust standard errors remain valid even if the assumed within-task correlation structure is incorrect ( Liang and Zeger, 1986 ) .
paragraphs.zh: （任务数量）多个 CWE 仅基于一个或两个任务，因此每个 CWE 的结果可能反映特定任务的特性。 因此，我们将它们视为对基准任务的观察结果，而非关于 CWE 的一般性结论。 为降低虚假效应带来的风险，我们手动检查了回归结果，发现这些结果在不同模型间存在一种具体的模式，例如针对 CWE-400，通过调用方的模式构建正则表达式。 在我们的图表中，没有任何功能上合理样本的单元格以空心形式呈现，且我们的任何结论都不依赖于此类样本较少的单元格。 （汇总分析）由于每个任务都出现在各个阶段和层级中，我们采用按任务分组的 GEE 模型进行拟合。 在包含 119 个分组的情况下，即使假设的任务内相关结构不正确，其系数估计值和聚类稳健标准误仍然有效（Liang and Zeger, 1986）。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we studied how the functionality-security gap of code generated by LLMs evolves across 32 models from seven families, two proprietary and five open-weight, over three stages and two tiers. Every family narrows the gap significantly by its newest stage, but none closes it, and the gap narrows only where security grows faster than functional plausibility. Openness does not decide how a family evolves. When the tiers differ significantly, the compact model is less secure in eight of nine cases. CWE-117 and CWE-113 remain insecure in almost every model, newer versions can regress on individual weaknesses, and C has the highest CVR in most models. In future work, we plan to extend our evaluation with the secure mode of CWEval, whose prompts include an instruction to write secure code, and to compare how this instruction changes the generation of vulnerable code across stages and tiers. We also plan to study how the security of code produced by coding agents evolves across their successive versions, keeping the underlying model fixed to separate the effect of the agent from that of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码的功能性与安全性之间的差距，是如何在七个模型家族（两个专有模型和五个开放权重模型）的 32 个模型中，经过三个阶段和两个层级逐步演变的。 每个模型家族在其最新阶段都显著缩小了这一差距，但没有一个能完全消除它；只有当安全性增长速度快于功能合理性时，这一差距才会缩小。 开放性并不决定一个模型家族的演变方式。 当层级存在显著差异时，紧凑型模型在九种情况中有八种情况下安全性较低。 CWE-117 和 CWE-113 在几乎所有模型中仍存在安全问题，新版本可能在个别弱点上出现退化，而 C 语言在大多数模型中的 CVR 最高。 在未来的工作中，我们计划通过引入 CWEval 的安全模式来扩展我们的评估——其提示词包含编写安全代码的指令，并比较这一指令在不同阶段和层级中如何改变脆弱代码的生成方式。 我们还计划研究由编码智能体生成的代码的安全性如何在其后续版本中演变，同时保持底层模型不变，以区分智能体效应与模型效应的影响。
